leaves.name: sga1_XII_3_3a

leaves.source: SGA 1 (Grothendieck, LNM 224, 1971), Exp. XII, Remarque 3.3(a), p. 325 (page per the 11-16 review), with the analytic space of XII 1.1 (locators UNVERIFIED)
